findings.title: Add a loader test for explicit `open`
findings.description: Task 1.4 tests the omitted-policy default, `wrap`, and `reflect`, but not an explicit `policy: open` value. The slice requires the loader to accept all three values, so add a test confirming that explicit `open` loads as `BoundsPolicy.OPEN`.

findings.title: Assert full config equality in the round-trip test
findings.description: Task 1.4 says the YAML round-trip test should assert that the policy matches. Slice success criterion 5 requires reloading the emitted YAML to produce an equal `ServerConfig`. Assert equality with the original config, in addition to checking the serialized policy value.

findings.title: Format commit markers as standalone plain lines
findings.description: The commit markers are written as checklist items (`- [ ] **Commit:** ...`), but the required format is a plain line, never a checkbox: `**Commit**: ...`. The markers are otherwise placed at reasonable tested points between phases.

findings.title: Remove the duplicate full-suite run
findings.description: Tasks 3.5 and 5.1 both require running the full test suite. Keep one full-suite run after the shipped config files are updated, and remove or relocate the earlier run. This would reduce unnecessary verification in an already detailed breakdown.
